local_exports.environment_description: Local Docker deployment, same actual run resumed; CDP attachment body unavailable and independently HTTP-verified.
checks: deployment enables actual VIO execution
active run exposes a reason without offering an archive
active run export is rejected by the API
cancelled request has an explicit unavailable state and no archive button
cancelled request cannot obtain a reproduction archive
actual nondefault computation has complete retained export evidence
run detail identifies external data and runtime requirements
unsupported or ambiguous export format requests fail explicitly
interrupted download preserves the run and enables retry
keyboard activation saves a verified real ZIP attachment
repeated downloads of the unchanged source have identical bytes
desktop export detail has no horizontal page overflow
archive identity and controls fit a 390 px viewport
the exact run export remains available after refresh
navigation cancels a pending export without a late download
unauthenticated clients cannot download another user’s archive
another account cannot download the retained successful export
another account sees no private run or export controls
server logout clears private content and prevents a pending download
cancelling the delete confirmation preserves export access
deleting the successful source revokes subsequent hosted export access
the already downloaded experiment remains intact after source deletion
deleting the run preserves its saved configuration
no uncaught browser or CSP errors occurred
limitations: Local qualification resumed on the same exact actual execution after a Playwright response-body assertion failure. The first nine checks are retained from the initial report. Only the exact QA owner password was reset by the operator to resume real browser authentication; the temporary handoff was deleted after reading. The archive and scientific outputs come from one actual successful nondefault execution. A separate cancelled request demonstrates unavailable evidence; failed or expired retained files require separate backend tests.

The initial CDP attachment body read returned zero bytes despite matching actual Content-Length and saved ZIP SHA. The final harness records missing CDP bodies and verifies a separate actual authenticated HTTP response byte-for-byte.
Timing includes network, browser hashing and automation within the stated scope; it is not isolated server CPU time, sustained throughput or a latency guarantee.
A transport interruption and request delays are injected deliberately; no scientific data, archive bytes or job states are mocked.
Successful deletion revokes subsequent hosted requests. It cannot erase bytes already downloaded, and this browser script does not establish asynchronous physical cleanup.
A real server logout is performed; no elapsed session-expiry duration is claimed.
The downloaded archive is retained for a separate independent reproduction check after source deletion; browser checks alone do not establish that reproduction succeeds.
Created accounts, project, experiment and cancelled request remain for exact operator cleanup.

downloads.timing_scope: Node monotonic time from browser request event to the browser download event and CDP body read attempt; includes network, browser SHA-256 verification and automation overhead, and excludes the separate HTTP verification request.

local_workspace_regression.environment_description: Local Docker deployment, system Chrome, regression after export increment.
checks: deployment serves a Content-Security-Policy header
registration creates an authenticated empty private workspace
created project uses a persistent UUID route
project description renders as text rather than HTML
catalog reference coverage is shown independently
no disconnected execution controls exist
project persists across refresh and deep links
project name and description save through backend
new projects have an empty experiment collection
new experiment uses the API profile default
creating an experiment persists immutable version 1
editing creates version 2 and exact parameter differences
version 1 retains its exact original specification and hash
saving unchanged fields does not create a version
historical revision is read only and retains its saved value
historical version deep links survive refresh
duplication uses the selected historical version and records provenance
experiment deletion has a cancellable confirmation
deleting a copied experiment removes its revisions
cancelling unsaved navigation keeps the experiment draft
a concurrent client saves version 3
optimistic conflict preserves all draft fields
adopting a newer base refreshes the displayed history while preserving the draft
explicit conflict recovery saves the retained draft as version 4
comparison identifies every changed supported field
experiment launch availability matches the server capability
experiment history and comparison fit a 390 px viewport
expanded immutable specification fits a 390 px viewport
private drafts are not persisted in browser storage
project results never borrow the external qualification run
light theme persists on reload
data view has no horizontal overflow at 390 px
expanded provenance has no horizontal overflow at 390 px
project list has no horizontal overflow at 390 px
a second account cannot open the first account project
cross-account GET PATCH DELETE all return 404
cross-account experiment reads mutations history comparison and duplication return 404
real CSRF rejection is displayed with session reload recovery
CSRF rejection did not create a project
missing cookie / unauthorized response clears private project content
delete confirmation can be cancelled
delete removes the live project
logout invalidates the server session
sign-in view has no horizontal overflow at 390 px
legacy explorer loads its recorded data
legacy explorer navigation remains functional
no uncaught browser errors in workspace or explorer
workspace and explorer have no CSP console errors
all loaded web fonts are ready
limitations: Browser checks do not independently establish the database engine, service-restart persistence, deployment host or network topology.
HTTP transport only; HTTPS and secure-cookie behavior are not validated.
Unauthorized-session behavior is checked by removing cookies; actual server-side expiry requires a separate backend test.
The two created QA accounts remain for administrator cleanup; this script does not delete accounts.
